source_text: Klagel. Jerem. 3, 4. Συμφορὰ γὰρ ἐπίμονος γεροντικὴν ἀσθένειαν ἐμποιεῖ.
pass_a_gloss: [Pass A] For a persistent calamity produces an old man’s weakness.
pass_b_english: For a persistent calamity produces an old man’s weakness (Lamentations 3:4).

choices.why: Lam 3:7 iron collar / yoke of people under divine permission.
